name: Resumption of Botswana Citizenship

qualifying_event.description: A person who previously held Botswana citizenship by birth or descent, but subsequently lost or renounced it, may apply to resume it.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Previous Botswana passport or Omang; copy of Botswana's Renunciation Certificate (if applicable).

requirements.blocker_text: Previously held Botswana citizenship through birth or descent before it was lost or ceased.
Previous Botswana passport or Omang, and if applicable the Renunciation Certificate.

evidence_required.document: Proof of parents' citizenship (certified passport, Omang, or citizenship certificate)
Copy of Botswana's Renunciation Certificate (if applicable)

sources.title: gov.bw (Botswana government portal), Department of Immigration and Citizenship -- Citizenship Requirements: Resumption of Botswana Citizenship: for those who lost citizenship held by birth/descent, Form S, ~1 month processing, Certificate of Resumption issued on approval

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Botswana). Directly sourced to gov.bw's own resumption service page -- modeled PUBLISHED. This is a distinct route from bw_citizenship_by_descent.json (an original claim to citizenship never yet exercised) and from bw_citizenship_naturalisation.json (a person with no prior Botswana citizenship claim): resumption is specifically for former citizens (by birth or descent) who lost that status -- most commonly by not making the required declaration to retain dual citizenship at age 21 (see bw_citizenship_by_descent.json's dual-citizenship-at-21 rule) -- and are reclaiming it, notably the fastest-processing citizenship route found in this build (~1 month vs ~1 year for naturalisation and spouse routes).
